note: ODNR Division of Forestry campground on the east side of Harrison State Forest. Paved trailer pads; paved access road handles small/medium RVs. (Separate Trailriders horse camp excluded.) --Claude
summary: Confirmed on ODNR's forest page and map: 7 family sites, free, self-register (not reservable, first-come), vault latrines, no water. Hookups left as derived (ODNR doesn't list them beyond 'provide their own water'). Note trimmed of the facts the fields now hold. Pin is ~230 m from the centre of OSM's 'Ronsheim Campground' polygon (40.32961,-80.98790), at its south-west corner; under the ~250 m line, so left.
flags: Phone missing: ODNR gives the forest manager, Ryan Zeisler, (740) 266-6021 (administrative office at Fernwood State Forest; Columbus HQ (877) 247-8733).

Rig length: ODNR's pages say nothing about RV size at Ronsheim; the note's 'paved access road handles small/medium RVs' is not agency wording (the inclusion evidence, from Hipcamp/search, said 'big rigs able to navigate'), so the agency-wording rule doesn't bite. No site lengths are published.

Season unstated: the forest is open 6 a.m.-11 p.m. daily with legal campers present overnight; no campground season is published. (The current notice closes the separate Trailriders Campground Oct 26-30, 2026, not Ronsheim.)
